title: See what a team member has been doing

steps.caption: Team
steps.narration: Want to know what someone on your team did today? Every member has an activity log.

steps.caption: Signed in as Priya
steps.narration: First, some work to log. This is Priya, in sales, signed in as herself.

steps.caption: Open a client
steps.chapter: A team member records a payment

steps.caption: The amount
steps.narration: types the amount of a check,

steps.caption: Back as the owner
steps.narration: Now back to you, on the Team tab.

steps.caption: Activity
steps.narration: Find Priya, and choose Activity under her name.

steps.caption: The line
steps.narration: There it is: who, what, the amount, the invoice, and the time.

steps.caption: What is logged
steps.narration: The log keeps estimates, invoices, client changes and payments, newest first.

steps.caption: Hide activity
steps.narration: Choose Hide activity to close it.

steps.caption: Nothing yet
steps.narration: Someone with nothing logged yet says so.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Only the owner can open these logs. They are under Team and Company.

youtube.title: How to see what a team member did | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Open a team member's activity log in ConstructHUB CRM. A team member records a check payment, then the owner opens Team, chooses Activity under her name and reads the line: who, what, the amount, the invoice and the time. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo team.
